reviews.text:
I've always had a dog, sometimes even two, and I've always used Oliva Nelly's modern grooming salon. Lately, specifically with the last two groomings, I've been dissatisfied. In the first case, the exact opposite of what I'd requested was done, and I thought there was a misunderstanding. Yesterday, Saturday, August 22nd, I had explained my wishes in detail. Cherie was delivered to me with a completely hairless patch, the size of a two-euro coin, to the left of her tail. I went to the vet, who reassured me, as I feared a dermatological condition, and told me there were no skin problems and the hair would grow back. At least I could have been warned of the mistake I'd made!!!! I'm very annoyed by what's happened in the last two months. At least a word of apology.
Angela Cortese
P.S. If I've returned so many times for all my dogs, it means I've always been satisfied. So why not be kind enough to let me know? Just a matter of tact.

You were very kind, and I thank you. I consider myself a serious and precise person. First of all, I didn't pick up Cherie personally this time, and to be honest, I didn't even deliver her. I'm quite old, so my daughter came. I noticed the round, hairless patch on the left side of her tail and thought it was dermatitis, but I certainly didn't think the dermatitis was caused by bathing or something else. I thought Cherie already had dermatitis and that I hadn't noticed. For this reason, I consulted the vet, who reassured me completely. At this point, the fact remains that Cherie has this hairless patch, which isn't caused by a skin condition. I'm temporarily unable to return to show her, and I won't even send her a photo. I've always been happy with the staff's work and have never complained. Cherie is three years old and is regularly bathed and treated every 30 days. Just as I've always trusted monthly treatments, I think you should also consider that I'm not a visionary, I'm not pedantic, and above all, I'm not rude. We've all seen Cherie's patch at home, including the vet. The hair will grow back easily, so there's no problem. Let me know if I can bring Cherie next month without any problems, and above all, accept that you're excellent at running your business. You have a wonderful staff, but everyone can make mistakes, and a little know-how doesn't hurt because not all clients are the same. Thank you.

Today I took my poodle, who had previously been badly clipped by another groomer, to a grooming salon. They fixed the situation by giving him a beautiful cut, at a fair price, and they were also very kind.
A star without motivation 😂😂😂 ridiculous 😂😂😂😂…. …

I took my golden retriever for a haircut, and I'm sorry to say this, but they're truly incompetent. They completely cut off his wonderful V on his chest.
Sometimes I wonder what it takes to admit you're incapable of doing certain jobs... 🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬 …

After taking my poodle Celine four times now, I can confidently say I've found a go-to.

I discovered this salon for its excellent reputation in Rome, and even though it's not the easiest place for me to get there, I continue to choose them for my more serious washes and cuts. I'd tried other groomers in the past, but here I found something special.

The owner is truly excellent: she works with great professionalism, patience, and attention, always listening to my requests and offering the best advice. She's extremely helpful, kind, and you can tell she's passionate about what she does. Her daughter is also a key figure at the salon: always courteous, knowledgeable, and attentive to the customer. The same goes for the entire staff, who are always welcoming and professional.

The prices are absolutely fair, and the atmosphere is one of people who work with heart.

Thank you for everything, Celine will definitely be back!
Very kind, fast and professional
Thank you ☺️
In my opinion, the prices are too high and they're rising out of proportion, regardless of the workmanship and time. They're happy to pocket this kind of money... in Parioli you spend less.

I've been taking my poodle, Tony, to Toelettatura Moderna for a while now, and I couldn't be happier with my choice. Poodle grooming requires precision and care, and the staff always excels: they're always excellent, professional, and incredibly attentive to my every request.

I brought my poodle in, simply asking for a slight trim of her back hair, teardrop legs, and a simple head trim. Instead, they completely shaved her, resulting in a very rough cut, with clumps of hair sticking out in various places.
In addition to the poor cosmetic work, I found a scab on my dog's neck. After a vet check, I was told it was a cut likely caused during grooming. What disappointed me most was that, when I picked her up, no one informed me of the incident.
I understand that accidents can happen, but fairness and transparency with the customer should be paramount.
A very negative experience. I would not recommend this groomer!

I've been bringing my little friend here for a year and a half and I'm very happy with it. I can't find any negatives to report. Only friendliness from the owner and the staff, who welcome my Benji with great enthusiasm😊 and love❤️ …
Very good and kind. One of them, whom I still thank, removed a tick from my Golden Retriever. But other than that, they do an excellent job. I recommend them to everyone.

I must say that they are very good, professional and helpful and having a Maltese dog, the quality of the cut is very important. Then and above all, the huge advantage is that no reservation is required.

I've been taking my dog ​​to Nelly Oliva for 3 years, and it gets better every time. Attention, care, and great love for our four-legged friends. Always smiling and ready to satisfy every request.
The entire staff is top-notch!!!

I'm not one to comb my dog ​​every day! And I'm aware of it! But if I have to choose between my dog's aesthetics and his well-being, I'll travel 100 hours to take him to Nelly! At least I'm sure he's treated well!!! ❤️ And for me, that's more important than anything else! Thank you 🙏! Kisses, sweetheart! …
Never bring cats here, they tell you they'll take them but then they handle them in a room full of dogs... they may be great with dogs but not with cats!
After changing groomers from Fabrizio di Gianlorenzo I met Nelly where they are punctual, courteous and available to answer any of my requests.
Good, good and fast
Terrible value for money, toiletry needs a complete overhaul, lousy staff! Luckily, there are other people who think like me!
All the staff are super kind and professional and above all they treat our 4-legged friends very well.

This has been my trusted and go-to groomer for years.
They always treat my Maltese with the utmost care and provide perfect care.
The staff is kind and highly qualified.
(They also accept walk-ins without an appointment).

How to turn a bichon into a gremilin. Never see you again. (I'm reading your reply now and I reply: shame, shame, shame, take responsibility for the mess you made today and thank me for not offending you. Twice in the emergency room with inflamed eyes and from what you told me today he's not the only one. I'm stupid for trusting you again. Change jobs, the 40-year story is old...

I've always been there and never had any problems, but today I saw with my own eyes from the front door my dog ​​being mistreated by one of the employees. He grabbed him roughly by the nose (lifting him up!), yelled at him, and pushed him against the wall where they dry them. My poor dog is too good and didn't react, just cried and tried to run away (obviously, I'd say), and he continued to mistreat him. When I protested, the owner (or at least if it wasn't her, it was the lady at the register, wearing glasses and writing down the names and phone numbers of the dogs and their owners) apologized to me and told me she was mortified by the employee's behavior and that she won't let him handle my dog ​​again. I obviously paid in full because I'm not looking for senseless discounts, but obviously I will never set foot in this place again because trust has collapsed. If anyone should say that what I'm saying isn't true, I have witnesses, other customers who were there. I'm truly disappointed. Ps: when I spoke to the employee directly he replied in broken Italian "next time I'll leave it like this".
Thank you 😍 …

This is my third dog, a Maremma mix, and they know how to handle and help. I wouldn't trade them for anything in the world: their great availability and attentiveness to my needs, as well as their patience and unparalleled professionalism. Plus, they're professionals you can always talk to.
Great service, they gave my dog back, clean and perfumed
Nelly is number 1

I took my two cookers there, and a groomer shaved them instead of stripping them! Despite calling and sending photos (even after we returned), the owner didn't even bother to call back, and her assistant hung up on us like a total jerk. In my opinion, if you pay for a service and get a worse one, not only does it ruin your dog's fur, you're being scammed. So dishonest, incompetent, and rude, what else could I say? At least a "sorry" would have been enough. Instead, pride and money rule the roost.
Thank you ☺️
Thank you 🙏 …
Very kind and professional, my dog ​​was groomed to perfection. Thank you.
excellent as always

Very, very satisfied with the work they did for Trixie!!! Highly recommended!!!!
Bonus: THEY ALSO TAKE WITHOUT A RESERVATION!!! Wonderful!!!!!!!
Thanks again

Very professional and kind, I'm happy with them even though I'm coming from the other side of Rome. There are no reservations, which is a great advantage. Not all groomers are the same, but I highly recommend them.
Very professional and courteous
Thank you ☺️.
Thank you ☺️
Nice, experienced and very effective staff

This morning we dropped off our little 5.5-month-old Jack Russell for his first peeing session... the staff were incredibly kind and empathetic, both with us and with the puppy, who greeted everyone so happy afterward!!! Thank you so much, see you next time!!
Thank you 🙏😊 …
Very kind and professional staff, I love the secretary and her coffee! Prices are in line with the times, I didn't need an appointment as there are more groomers.
Thank you 🙏 . …

Extremely negative review. I took my elderly (but healthy) dog to be washed, and they returned her to me without fully complying with my requests. I was traumatized, and I strongly suspect they'd hurt her because she hadn't been able to walk properly for a week (since the day I brought her).
Apparently, mixed breeds aren't popular (but not the owner's money).

I had a truly unpleasant and disrespectful experience with your staff when I received my dog. The lady in charge complained about some knots in her fur (which, incidentally, were perfectly removed by another groomer), pointing out that the cost would be far above the base price and that the dog would be shaved. We're talking about a Toy Poodle, weighing less than three and a half kilos.
You offer a service, but that doesn't give you the right to mistreat a customer, belittle them, or make them feel like an idiot. The other groomer combed my dog; yes, there were knots, but not enough to warrant a shave. The other groomer did an excellent job, returning my dog ​​clipped and bathed for an excellent price.
I'm sorry, but the courtesy and kindness I'd experienced in the past have disappeared, not to mention the exorbitant price increase.
Goodbye.

I came this morning with my dog, who is very fearful and suspicious. The staff was truly excellent and attentive, not only in their physical care but also in trying to establish a trusting relationship with her. One operator, Valentina (a little one), in particular, took such loving care of her. Highly recommended, I'll definitely be back!
Thank you 🙏 …
Excellent grooming service. The staff is knowledgeable, helpful, kind, and friendly. Great attention and care for the animal. Reasonable prices. Highly recommended.

I brought my dog ​​back in a terrible state of health after a day in the countryside. Modern Grooming did an excellent job of washing, combing, and so on, leaving me with a clean, soft, and fragrant coat. Excellent, highly qualified staff.

I've been a customer for about a year. Initially, the staff was attentive and did a clean job at a good price. Now they've started to be rude and increased the price by €20 for a terrible job (her head was asymmetrical and tufts of hair were sticking out). So I had to take her back to have her head at least reshaped. The dog has still been TREMBLING with fear since she left. I don't know what happened, but we definitely won't be returning.
Very satisfied
Thank you ☺️
Thank you ☺️

A very positive first experience.
They were kind and patient, took care of my big puppy, and returned him to me clean and smelling fresh.
We'll definitely be back.

A month ago, I took my dog ​​for grooming (I'd already been there two weeks earlier and paid €45). This time, I expected to pay a little less since it wasn't much work. And no, still €45.
I understand it's not an easy job, but you have to evaluate carefully because €45 is a full day's work for someone.
I'll edit to add something.

You didn't get the message. Can you tell me what the price is based on? Since there are so many people working there, everyone sets a price. And it happened to me that after two weeks, I came back because we'd been to the park and she was dirty (her hair was short), but not like you say, two and a half hours; in fact, after a bit of an hour, I already received the call to come. I have respect for everyone, but you too should try to be more careful when setting the price. My dog ​​has never been there for more than 2 hours, always 1 hour 30 minutes or 1 hour 45 minutes when everything needed to be done. So when someone criticizes you, it doesn't mean they're underestimating your work; it should be a mutual act of respect.

Terrible.
I had already reviewed them, but the review *magically* disappeared despite having so many likes.
I'll try again.
The last time I brought my medium poodle puppy, they gave him an unprofessional haircut, even though I'd recommended the owner do the job. There was a girl doing the test that day, and perhaps she was the one who did it. All serious groomers know that scissor trimming a poodle is NOT a job for everyone.
Furthermore, the nails were cut too short and, perhaps, cauterized. Photos follow.

Reliability with the owner is a plus, but respect for the dog is a must.
I strongly advise against it.
The owners' response gets 7 likes in my opinion.
They are the real "dogs."
There's nothing to laugh about.

This was my first time here and I was very satisfied.
I'll become a regular customer. Congratulations!!!

I've been bringing my poodle here for a while now, and I've always had a great time!
I recommend it to everyone!

I have been taking my Maltese dogs to the grooming salon on Via Gregorio XI for years. The staff is kind, polite and meticulous about the work carried out under the guidance of Nelly with more than 30 years of experience 👍🤩 …

We've brought many dogs here, both Poodles and Pomeranians, and have always been satisfied with the results.
The staff has always been friendly and attentive, offering helpful advice.
I absolutely recommend them.
Thank you 🙏 …

Yesterday, I had a terrible experience after 15 years of going to Olivia Nelly's modern grooming salon. I took my Airedale terrier for a stripping. I was quoted a price of $100 to $120, only to find myself charged $150, plus $30 for no reason and without warning.
The grooming was also performed incorrectly, as the eyebrows were shaved, which should be left long, a distinctive trait of this breed.
Terrible in every way, never again!

Bad experience, especially considering the price previously agreed upon, only to then show up to pick up the dog and be charged a €30 surcharge. The staff were rude and pushy, and even called me a liar in front of customers.

Considering I'd been a customer for 10 years.

Never again!

Today, I had a negative and rude experience with your staff when I picked up my dog. The lady in charge complained about the knots (which were also very well removed by another groomer elsewhere) and told me that the price exceeded €70, and the dog was shaved to the skin. We're talking about a Toy Poodle, less than 2 kg in weight and 20 centimeters tall, but what bothered me was the arrogance of the aforementioned person in reprimanding the girl called to inspect the fur after she had quoted a price that she immediately corrected upwards. You offer a service that doesn't give you the right to reprimand a customer, belittle them, or treat them as imbeciles. Your competitor groomed my dog; yes, there were knots, but they weren't considered sufficient to shave the dog to the skin. The competition did an excellent job by returning my dog ​​to me, clipped and washed, for 45 euros. I'm sorry, but the courtesy and kindness I had previously encountered was missing, in addition to the huge increase in price........ Never again.

My experience at Tolettatura Moderna, owned by the Merini family, was truly excellent, and I can't help but recommend it to all dog owners looking for a place where their pets can feel truly pampered. It's not just a grooming salon, but a true wellness center for dogs.

As soon as we arrived, Balto and I were warmly welcomed by Nelly and Federica, the owners, who immediately put us at ease with their experience and professionalism. They clearly know their craft, not only in the quality of their service, but also in the attention and care they give to each individual dog.

Another strong point of this center is the use of completely natural products, developed and produced directly by the Merini family. This is a guarantee of quality, and I was pleased to learn that the products are designed for the well-being of animals' fur and skin, without harmful chemicals. This, in my opinion, combined with their experience, really makes the difference.

In closing, the Merini family's Modern Grooming is the ideal place for those seeking quality service, but also an environment where dogs are treated with love, respect, and professionalism.

Congratulations to everyone, including Maurizio. You are professionals who put passion and love into every detail of their work!
See you soon!
What can I tell you? Every time I take my dog ​​to them, I'm always satisfied. Not only do they pamper him, but they also pamper me. 🤣🤣🤣... …
Fully satisfied with the grooming work done on my two West Highland Terriers
Professionalism, in welcoming the small and large love dogs, and it's always a pleasure to take them to the grooming, chicks come in and cogni come out. Thanks girls ..vot DieciELode
Welcoming and professional place, the right place for my Taty, thank you
Thank you 🙏😍 …
Thank you 🙏 …
Very kind staff and what can I say, I'm very satisfied with the cut of my poodle

Update
I brought back Stellina, my elderly dog, this year, and they washed and cleaned her wonderfully... and she's feeling better, too... plus, the staff was kind enough to carry her in my car...
Last year, I brought my elderly dog ​​with various issues to the new center, and she was washed and dried slowly... slowly, and the person who cared for her was very kind and attentive. My other dog also had her fur fixed, which is matted and knotted in some places... while a few years ago with another dog, I had been dealing with the same situation.
Furthermore, you don't need to make an appointment, which is very convenient.
Thank you ☺️
Professionalism, courtesy, and great care for the animals. These guys are incredibly kind and helpful!

The best center you can find!
100% professional, 100% courteous, 100% satisfied!!
They're the best!!! I've been going to them for years and my dog ​​is so happy!!!!

All that glitters is not gold. My dog's left cornea was punctured at this groomer with the tip of a pair of scissors. Not only that, but they made me take the dog to be washed twice, then asked me to pick him up because they didn't have time. Of course, the excuse was "your dog is bad." And you are all charlatans.
